title: `GoogleModel`: any native tool on Gemini 3+ fails on Vertex because `include_server_side_tool_invocations` is set
author: jgurney

comments.author: pydanty[bot]
comments.body:
<!-- pydanty:status-comment:v1 -->

## pydanty status: bug -- confirmed (high), signal 7/10 - p:2-high

**Why:** Any user combining native tools (WebFetch, WebSearch, FileSearch) with a Gemini 3+ model on Vertex gets a guaranteed client-side ValueError before any API call. This blocks a core feature combination on a Tier-1 provider (Google Vertex). The fix is narrow: don't set the Vertex-incompatible parameter when the provider is GoogleCloudProvider.
**Evidence:** Repositorian (checked-in code reading): profiles/google.py L77 sets `google_supports_server_side_tool_invocations=is_3_or_newer` from model name only — no provider awareness. models/google.py L745-753 `_get_tool_config` sets `include_server_side_tool_invocations=True` when native tools are present and the profile flag is set, with no provider check. PR #5336 established the GoogleProvider/GoogleCloudProvider split. No duplicate issue or prior maintainer decision found.

Explorer (google-genai SDK v1.74.0 primary source): `_ToolConfig_to_vertex` raises `ValueError: include_server_side_tool_invocations parameter is not supported in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.` when the field is set; `_ToolConfig_to_mldev` passes it through. Developer-API-only parameter.

These two sources form a complete logical chain: model-name-only profile → unconditional parameter set → SDK rejects for Vertex.

Reproduction was NOT completed — reproducer delegate was unavailable (budget exhausted). No runtime script or playground share was produced. The bug mechanism is confirmed from static code analysis + SDK source, not from a running test. code_librarian was also unavailable; how GoogleModel detects its provider type at runtime is unconfirmed from checked-in code and is documented as a known gap in the PR-ready handoff for the PR opener to resolve.
**Next:** pr_ready -- Bug confirmed from repositorian code reading + explorer SDK primary source; fix is narrow (skip include_server_side_tool_invocations for Vertex). Reproducer and code_librarian were unavailable (budget exhausted), not evidence gaps — proceeding on partial evidence per policy.

@adtyavrdhn -- assigned for prioritization (p:2-high, signal 7/10).
